blocks.orig: The Salinero Kilimanjaro Lodge lies in a leafy suburb, at a 3-kilometre drive from Moshi town. The rooms are well-ventilated and specially designed to make you comfortable after a hectic day, as they are equipped with a refrigerated mini-bar, tea and coffee-making facilities, an ensuite bathroom, wireless internet, and satellite television. The restaurant here serves dishes made with fresh, seasonal produce from its own kitchen garden. Besides, a pool is available for a dip, and a large outdoor area set in an oasis of lush gardens offers relaxing chairs and an atmosphere designed to make you feel right at home.
blocks.html: In a green, leafy suburb just a 3-kilometre drive from Moshi town lies The Salinero Kilimanjaro Lodge. The rooms are airy and built for comfort after a busy day: each has its own bathroom, a refrigerated mini-bar, facilities for making tea and coffee, satellite TV and wireless internet. Dishes at the restaurant are prepared with seasonal, fresh ingredients grown in the lodge's kitchen garden. You can also cool off in the pool, while the spacious outdoor space, an oasis of green gardens, has comfortable chairs and a relaxed atmosphere that makes you feel at home.
